description:
Welcome to Space Weavers!

We are a team of students and space enthusiasts participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge. We are passionate about science, technology, creativity, and innovation, and we aim to build a project that is meaningful, interactive, and engaging.
summary: Space Relics is an interactive educational storytelling platform that explores NASA's abandoned and forgotten space hardware across the Moon and Mars. Designed for students and space enthusiasts, it brings these forgotten missions back to life through an interactive map, mission timelines, historical stories, images, and scientific discoveries. Users can explore where these objects were left behind, learn why they were abandoned, and discover how each piece of technology contributed to space exploration.
details:
Space Relics is an interactive educational web application developed by Team Space Weavers for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, addressing the challenge “Abandoned but not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA's Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars.”
Our project aims to bring the forgotten stories of space exploration back to life by transforming the history of NASA's abandoned space equipment into an engaging learning experience. Rovers, landers, spacecraft, and scientific instruments left behind on the Moon and Mars represent important milestones in humanity's exploration of space. We want users to understand that these objects are more than discarded machinery; they are valuable pieces of scientific and historical heritage.
